text:
mina: Quick sync we need to cover streaming + auth interop for the LangChain/LlamaIndex gateway demo. Main asks: signed JWTs for streaming sessions, marketplace billing mapping, and an SI acceptance checklist.

rahul: For streaming sessions we should mint a session token that binds to a connection_id and expires after the socket closes. Example header: Authorization: Bearer <jwt> with claim {"sid": "conn-123", "exp": 1710000000, "scope": ["stream:read","stream:write"] }

tara: Ops: we'll need a billing mapping so marketplace trials hit a demo flag (no invoice). Can we map token namespace to billing:demo and quota 50k tokens?

ops-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-7022 - "Gateway streaming token format + marketplace billing mapping" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTNER-7022

rahul: Also recommend multiplexing a single socket for multiple tool calls to reduce handshake overhead; include connection keepalive and a short TTL (max 24h) for long demos.

mina: SI acceptance checklist items: sandbox creds, streaming session example, deterministic prompt pack, smoke tests for tool-call passthrough, and rollback to quantized model.

legal: We'll need an attestation PDF and partner logo approval before listing. No marketing superlatives without perf evidence.

tara: I'll add billing flag + quota config to PARTNER-7022 and upload a small demo script that shows stream handshake + tool-call via LangChain agent.

rahul: I'll push a minimal sample in the gist and paste link in the ticket with token examples and revoke command.

mina: timeline: demo dry-run Fri AM. Owners: rahul (token + sample), tara (billing + quota), legal (attestation). Try to close PRs by Thu EOD. :rocket:
